newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hai Hong says no decision on way to fund purchase.
newsitem.headline: Hai Hong says no decision on way to fund purchase.

text.p: China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday no decision had been made on the way to fund its purchase of assets from its parent China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd.

"No decision has been taken as to the form in which such fund raising might take place, no terms have been agreed and no decision to proceed has been taken by either China Merchants Holdings or the company," the company said in the statement.
"Furthermore, no indication can be given of the timing of any such decision to proceed," it said.

In March, the company said it was in preliminary talks of formulating a proposal involving acquiring certain investments from its 60 percent controlling shareholder, and the acquisitions, if implemented, would require fund raising by the company which might be in the form of a share placement.
The company's shares ended HK$0.15 up at HK$5.65 on Friday on volume of 26.60 million shares.
